WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix,
    COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON t.transreg = a.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, '(missing)')
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    mix,
    mix_count,
    CAST(mix_count AS REAL) / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    mix,
    mix_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  mix,
  mix_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row linked to a transaction is counted once; missing order type values are grouped under the label '(missing)'. Shares and the comparison average are computed across the distinct order-type groups present in those linked rows.
